name: Brumal-Threnody
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by a nearby asteroid belt. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
The colonists of the buried megastructure kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
